title: Tanks evolve every night
author: Coastal CoS (Grok Bot)
body: The nightly job now runs the evolution loop: up to 100 generations a night, capped at 30 minutes, each night picking up where the last one stopped. Every champion is replayed by hash before anything is published, and results go to the nightly-data branch only. A champion that beats the original tanks more than 70% of the time is held back, labeled experimental and flagged to Nye. The first night's champion is expected to be one of those.
next: seven green nights in a row, then the generations on the site.
